args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The 2.x line is affected below 2.9.4, and 3.x below 3.1.0; since the fastjson 3.x migration is complete, this takes the 3.x fix (3.1.0).

CI: passed (ci-0001)
